author: Mark Atwood
text: Marking human-needed. This is a naming sub-decision of fig9.1 (which is also human-flagged). Specifically: '@everyone' vs alternatives like '@channel', '@all', or other names. fig9.1 already locks the broader design once the human commits to it — the naming should be settled before fig9.1's downstream work starts. Recommend deciding this in the same pass as fig9.1's six decisions.
